key_insight: A dual-layer validation pipeline can make synthetic healthcare case generation more practical by filtering cases with LLM-based checks before expert educator review.
clinical_relevance: For health professional education, synthetic musculoskeletal cases may help expand training content while reducing privacy, licensing, and data-access barriers.
method: Generated 128 synthetic MSK cases with four frontier LLMs across 28 conditions
Screened cases with an LLM-as-judge pipeline for alignment, JSON correctness, relevance, bias, toxicity, and completeness
Had four MSK physiotherapy educators rate the remaining cases for accuracy, realism, fidelity, relevance, and usability
evidence_signal: Ninety cases passed automated screening; GPT-4.1 had the best pass rate and expert scores, and expert-rated cases showed strong validity for usability, relevance, and realism.
watch_item: Automated metrics only partly matched human judgment, so expert review is still needed to catch subtle clinical and contextual errors.
paper_title: PhysiCase: Development and dual-layer validation of synthetic cases for health professional education: A pilot study leveraging Generative AI
